sections.title: 7. Keys to the match
bullets: Win the cricket. Polonia has won 4 of 15 cricket games (27%) and lost all 3 in W6; we are 13 of 18 (72%). Expect Blake or Ray Wolf in their pairs – answer with Keppler (2.85) and Fromenko (2.68).
Take the 801s. Polonia is 8 of 20 in 801 (40%); we are 15 of 24 (62%). Their 501 is better (50%, vs our 44%), so the 501s are where the night is decided.
Make them check out. Polonia hits 20.7% on a double (17 of 82) and has 38 busts in 5 matches; in W2 they busted 10 times. Get to a double first and keep the pressure on.
They play close. Their last three matches were decided by one game (8-7 W, 7-8 L, 7-8 L), and they average 40.10 PPR to our 42.73. A 10-5 repeat is not a given, especially on their boards.
Watch BJ Ray and Jake Blake. BJ Ray (Co-captain, 32 games, the most on the team) played in 4 of Polonia's 5 wins against us in W2; Blake finished two of them (G9, G12).

groups.title: How Polonia beat us (5 games)
bullets: G1 801 – BJ Ray / Goldman / Pantalone: BJ Ray out 40 on his 3rd dart with us on 3. Dead even, 50.06 vs our 49.88.
G5 cricket – BJ Ray / Goldman 1.72 MPR beat Jeff / Vince 1.50; final 171-165.
G9 501 – BJ Ray / Blake / Ryan Wolf: Blake out 25 with us on 11 (36.66 vs 35.00).
G12 501 – BJ Ray / Blake / McCue: Blake out 6 with us on 2 (37.58 vs 35.64).
G13 501 – Ray Wolf / Goldman / Ryan Wolf: their best game, 46.97; Goldman out 40 with us on 110.

groups.title: Takeaways for Thursday
bullets: Three of Polonia's five wins came down to the last double (G1, G9, G12): we were left on 3, 11 and 2. We won the other close ones: G4 (Prelle out 2 with them on 2), G11 (them on 5) and G14 (them on 3).
BJ Ray was in four of their five wins (G1, G5, G9, G12). Ryan Wolf (46.19 that night) and Goldman also played well.
This is an away match. Polonia lost both home matches so far (W3 5-10 vs Brickhouse, W5 7-8 vs Gotti), but they have improved since W2 (team W4–6: 8-7, 7-8, 7-8).
